# flutter-build.yml

<link-summary>Inputs, secrets and outputs of the reusable workflow Flutter build.</link-summary>

```text
Builds Flutter apps for every enabled target, each on the runner it needs:

  web             ubuntu    build/web, also the part web of the GitHub Pages site
  apk, appbundle  ubuntu    signed when the ANDROID_* secrets are set
  ios, ipa        macos     signed when the APPLE_* secrets are set
  macos           macos     signed and, when asked, notarized
  linux-x64       ubuntu    linux-arm64 on an ARM runner
  windows-x64     windows   windows-arm64 on an ARM runner

Every build is an artifact flutter-<app>-<target>; with release-assets it is also an artifact
release-assets-flutter-<app>-<target> that github-release.yml attaches to the release.

Signing secrets that live in an environment only reach the build when `environment` names it.
```

```yaml
jobs:
  flutter-build:
    uses: davils-com/workflows/.github/workflows/flutter-build.yml@v1
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `working-directory` | string | `.` | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml, relative to the repository root. |
| `discovery` | string | empty | Packages discovered before (pipeline.yml passes its own); empty discovers them here. |
| `include` | string | empty | Globs of package directories outside the workspace, such as apps/*. |
| `exclude` | string | empty | Globs of package directories to leave out. |
| `apps` | string | empty | JSON array of app package names to build; empty builds every app (a Flutter package that is not published and has lib/main.dart and a platform directory). |
| `targets` | string | `{"web":"auto"}` | JSON object target -> true, false or auto (web, apk, appbundle, ios, ipa, macos, linux-x64, linux-arm64, windows-x64, windows-arm64); auto builds web for apps with a web directory. |
| `flutter-version` | string | `stable` | Flutter version (stable, beta or a version). |
| `flutter-version-file` | string | empty | File to read the Flutter version from (pubspec.yaml or .fvmrc); wins over flutter-version. |
| `build-mode` | string | `release` | release, profile or debug. |
| `flavor` | string | empty | Build flavor. |
| `target-file` | string | empty | Main entry point, such as lib/main_production.dart. |
| `dart-define-from-file` | string | empty | File with compile-time variables (JSON or .env), relative to the app. |
| `extra-args` | string | empty | Extra arguments for every flutter build command. |
| `build-name` | string | `pubspec` | pubspec (the version of the pubspec.yaml), version (the version input) or a literal build name. |
| `build-number` | string | `run-number` | run-number, pubspec or a literal build number. |
| `version` | string | empty | The release version, for build-name version. |
| `obfuscate` | boolean | `false` | Obfuscate Dart code; the symbols become an artifact flutter-<app>-<target>-symbols. |
| `web-wasm` | boolean | `false` | Build web with WebAssembly. |
| `android-split-per-abi` | boolean | `false` | Build one APK per ABI. |
| `android-signing` | string | `auto` | auto or true (sign when the ANDROID_* secrets are set; true fails without them) or false (never sign). |
| `apple-signing` | string | `auto` | auto or true (sign when the APPLE_* secrets are set; true fails without them) or false (never sign). |
| `export-options-plist` | string | empty | ExportOptions.plist for a signed ipa, relative to the app. |
| `macos-notarize` | boolean | `false` | Notarize and staple the macOS app (secrets APP_STORE_CONNECT_*). |
| `java-version` | string | `17` | Java version for Android builds. |
| `xcode-version` | string | empty | Xcode to select on macOS runners, such as 26.0; empty keeps the default. |
| `environment` | string | empty | Environment of the build jobs, for signing secrets stored in an environment. |
| `release-assets` | boolean | `false` | Also upload every build as release-assets-flutter-<app>-<target> for github-release.yml. |
| `pages-part-enabled` | boolean | `false` | Hand web builds to pages.yml as the part web. |
| `runners` | string | `{}` | JSON object of runner labels (linux, linux-arm, macos, windows, windows-arm). |
| `timeout-minutes` | number | `60` | Timeout of every build job. |
| `fail-fast` | boolean | `false` | Cancel the other builds when one fails. |
| `harden-runner` | boolean | `true` | Run step-security/harden-runner first on Linux runners. |
| `harden-runner-egress-policy` | string | `audit` | audit or block. |
| `harden-runner-allowed-endpoints` | string | empty | Endpoints allowed with the block policy, space separated. |
| `pre-setup` | string | empty | Shell commands run before any tool is set up. |
| `post-setup` | string | empty | Shell commands run after the dependencies are resolved. |
| `pre-build` | string | empty | Shell commands run in the app directory before the build; TARGET names the target. |
| `post-build` | string | empty | Shell commands run in the app directory after the build; ARTIFACT_DIR is the packaged output. |
| `artifact-retention-days` | number | `14` | Days to keep the build artifacts. |
| `pub-hosted-url` | string | empty | URL of a private package host; its token is the secret PUB_HOSTED_TOKEN. |
| `git-host` | string | `github.com` | Host of private git dependencies; its token is the secret GIT_DEPS_TOKEN. |

## Secrets

All secrets are optional.

- `PUB_HOSTED_TOKEN`
- `GIT_DEPS_TOKEN`
- `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64`
- `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`
- `ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS`
- `ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD`
- `APPLE_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64`
- `APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD`
- `APPLE_PROVISIONING_PROFILES_BASE64`
- `APPLE_TEAM_ID`
- `APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID`
- `APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID`
- `APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_P8_BASE64`

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `matrix` | The builds that ran, as a JSON matrix. |

## Permissions the caller grants

- `contents: read`
